source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'SRC_OLEDB_INCM_STG_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE') AS SRC_OLEDB_INCM_STG_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'SRC_OLEDB_INCM_STG_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE') AS SRC_OLEDB_INCM_STG_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DST_FF_INCM_FILE_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE') AS DST_FF_INCM_FILE_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DST_FF_INCM_FILE_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE') AS DST_FF_INCM_FILE_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DST_FF_INCM_FILE_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE') AS DST_FF_INCM_FILE_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01') AS DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01') AS DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01') AS DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01') AS DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'NC_DSNP_INCM' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DFT_GENERATE_FILE01') AS DFT_GENERATE_FILE01_sink_TableName;

scripts.text:
WITH CTE_BATCH AS (SELECT MAX(BATCH_ID) AS BATCH_ID FROM AGP.MB_NC_DSNP_BATCH )
SELECT FILENAME FROM AGP.MB_NC_DSNP_BATCH  WHERE BATCH_ID = (SELECT BATCH_ID FROM CTE_BATCH)
